svg.title: Compare a complete request under matched policies
svg.desc: Same model, tokens, stopping, scheduler, byte budgets and completion contracts
svg.text: Compare a complete request under matched policies
Same model, tokens, stopping, scheduler, byte budgets and completion contracts
First gate: valid output and safe lifetime
Check identities, initialized rows, masks, shared immutability and reference logits.
A faster result with missing context or early reuse fails before performance analysis.
C-reserve: 64 positions/request. P-page: 16 positions/block, growth budgeted.
Record reader differences; this compares storage-plus-reader paths, not allocation alone.
Largest diagnostic cohort: P = 31; G = 4; c = 4
Only three selected IDs are processed after prefill: N = 34 positions/request.
Synthetic k = 128 KiB/position → 32 MiB contiguous versus 24 MiB paged assigned.
Next vary one declared workload dimension
Use context/concurrency cells, then reuse order and independent arrivals.
Memory savings and hit counts are predictions; useful request performance needs evidence.
32 MiB is a KV payload budget. Weights, metadata, scratch and headroom need separate accounting.
